package service

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
)

// scenario for service_method_accepts_map_string_any_input: Services that use map-shaped dynamic input instead of typed request contracts.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
type CatalogService struct {
	repo CatalogRepository
}

func NewCatalogService(repo CatalogRepository) *CatalogService {
	return &CatalogService{repo: repo}
}

func (s *CatalogService) Update(params map[string]any) error {
	id, ok := params["id"].(string)
	if !ok || id == "" {
		return errors.New("id is required")
	}
	name, _ := params["name"].(string)
	price, _ := params["price"].(float64)
	if price <= 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid price: %v", price)
	}
	return s.repo.UpdateProduct(context.Background(), id, name, price)
}

type CatalogRepository interface {
	UpdateProduct(ctx context.Context, id, name string, price float64) error
}
